summary: Implemented the pure structural output validator and deterministic contextual detector corrections. JSON-compatible values retain shape and scalar types; provider-pattern and sensitive-field string credentials are masked; safe numeric IDs and metrics remain unchanged; numeric credential fields, unsupported schema constructs, schema-incompatible masks and non-JSON values return a constant leak-safe format-unsafe result. Sensitive URL query/path values and auto-fetch image surfaces are neutralized while ordinary public Markdown links remain content. The 22-case focused suite, 14-case root integration boundary, targeted ESLint and project TypeScript check pass.
summary_markdown: T19 is GREEN. `validateOutputForTransport` now provides the stable pure boundary for root guard/MCP wiring, with explicit JSON/text formats and typed redaction metadata. Focused verification: 22 core tests and 14 root integration boundary tests passed, targeted ESLint passed, and `bun run typecheck` passed. No global tests, network, model, dependency, git, or flow-state mutation occurred.

acceptance.criterion: Safe metrics and IDs retain values and types; provider-pattern secrets always masked despite key name.
acceptance.evidence: Pure JSON tests preserve finite numeric metrics, numeric and string IDs, decimals and booleans while masking provider-pattern credentials under id/metric keys. Generic strings under explicit credential keys are masked and numeric credential fields fail closed.

acceptance.criterion: Sensitive URL query/path values masked; ordinary public markdown link creates no exfil finding, autofetch/injection defenses remain.
acceptance.evidence: New deterministic URL query/path rules mask only credential value spans. Public inline/reference links are not exfil operations; Markdown images, reference images and HTML images remain redactable, sensitive inline-link locators remain findings, and existing send-operation/SSRF tests pass.

acceptance.criterion: Pure transport validator preserves JSON shape and reports metadata; unsafe numeric/schema representations return constant format-unsafe without secret or hash.
acceptance.evidence: The discriminated result preserves safe values and JSON serialization, keeps text unquoted and JSON string scalars quoted, emits sorted leak-safe policy reasons, screens the supported schema subset, and returns only the constant failure text plus reason tokens for unsafe cases.
